user_questions.question: Какие первые реальные данные будут в Bank: публичные, обычные приватные или чувствительные?
user_questions.why: Определяет controls и deployment boundary; нельзя считать локальную папку достаточной privacy acceptance.
user_questions.proposal: Продолжать synthetic fixtures; для real use принять controls по выбранному data class.
user_questions.blocking_scope: Corresponding real private/sensitive deployment acceptance; not synthetic design/development

user_questions.question: Нужны ли в MVP AI/embedding/analysis providers кроме ChatGPT, и какая граница передачи данных им допустима?
user_questions.why: Дополнительная отправка originals/derived text может менять privacy boundary; отсутствие provider integration не блокирует MVP.
user_questions.proposal: ChatGPT remains primary; do not add automatic exposure to other AI providers before this boundary is answered.
user_questions.blocking_scope: Extra-provider exposure only; not ordinary local storage or synthetic importer

user_questions.question: Достаточно ли в MVP доступа к Bank при включённом этом ПК, или доступ нужен даже когда он выключен?
user_questions.why: Always-available access can change topology, infrastructure and scope materially.
user_questions.proposal: Keep already selected local first path for current development; do not silently promise always-online/multi-device access.
user_questions.blocking_scope: Availability/deployment acceptance; not local synthetic development

unblocked_work: Prepare scoped minimal operations/search/ownership/retention contracts; synthetic data only until actual data boundary answered. Do not repeat completed tasks or accept R0/R1 from probes.

acceptance_checks.check: User data/provider/availability answers recorded without invented consent; choices mapped to applicable triggers
Minimal operation/search/ownership/retention blockers answered with schemas/expected IDs/compatibility evidence
R0 acceptance assessed separately; runtime LW gates remain separate and no late COND deferral

next_action: Record user answers and complete minimal R0 operation/search/ownership/retention contracts; create separate bounded synthetic importer card when its inputs are sufficient.
